verdict.tagline: Deep water rewards patience despite a steep initial climb.
for_you_if: you have the patience for a slow early game
you want a deep fishing simulation

citations.review_text:
[h3]Optional Rating [b]D[/b][/h3]

Came across this game while searching for free multiplayer games to try with friend in vacation. The main reason I played this was to spend time with friends in multiplayer. The game looked really fine in the overview but after having the first gameplay, it felt like what the purpose of the game really is. Tutorial, main menu, tasks so messed up and confusing that it took long for me to just find my friend in the multiplayer. Also am I only supposed to catch the fishes relentlessly to reach levels for unlocking other features. This was absolute hilarious and felt so boring. I am not going to say either it's worth or not since it's a free game. But not that much recommended for playing.

The game seems nice, and the fishing stuff looks interesting, but I got pushed away by the main menus that look very confusing to me, as well as the very lackluster character customisation. 
But the main reason I disliked the game was how it constantly kept giving me a pop-up to buy stuff after going into and out of a fishing session.
If I say no to a pop-up about buying something, stop opening it another 10 times in less than 5 minutes.
Very ad spammy and unintuitive. fustrated enough to uninstall before actually getting to play the game.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that progression feels heavily restricted behind steep paywalls and the need to purchase premium gear or currencies.

citations.review_text: Wanted to play a fun game to fish for when I can't go out and actually fish. This game is not it. Everything is locked behind levels and everything costs so much money like going places, it may be realistic but it's not a good realistic. It also feels like a lot of cool stuff to get is locked behind dlcs
Everything is pay to win, horrible design.

so i played for 30 minutes then got banned for no reason i contacted them they said i was cheating ive never cheated in any games a day in my life when i asked them to tell me me why they had no response. horrible support and honestly mid game better in the ol days on xbox. horrible updates made it hard to progress without buying ad ons that are extremely overpriced

While you can play free to play, it heavily pushes pay to win. Premium ads popping up everything you open your map, leave the map, try to go to the shop, change maps, etc. It is constantly spamming ads on you.

I just wanted to try the game to see if I would consider getting premium in the future. The answer is definite NO!

Also, there is a lot of stuff locked behind needing gold (premium currency called baitcoin) to fix or buy.

I get they are trying to make money off of a free to play game. However, they pay to win is absurd in this one. For that, I can't recommend it to anyone that is wanting to get any decent progress in the game. If you just want to throw a line in the water, and don't care about leveling and progress, then it is okay.
Gameplay mechanics aren't great and its heavily monotised.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that leveling up and progressing through locations requires a significant time investment or grind.

citations.review_text: Fishing in this game is extremely satisfying. It is so rewarding when you try again and again and finally catch a fish, Especially the big ones or trophy ones. They have tons of equipment that you can use and it is a progressive game where you need to level up to unlock better stuff and places. It requires some patience, potentially some money spent but for me personally, it is worth it.

i dont recommend, i will continue to play every now and then, but this game is straight up pay to win. ive been playing since it first came out. it is a GRIND to level up in order to get good bait or lures to catch anything worth money or exp. it took me a long time to get to i think it was level 16 to 20 just to get good cutbait so i can fish cats. i ended up buying the premium for 3 days and that made a  huge difference. i got a gift and i was able to buy a halloween pole collection and that basically unlocked the entire first part of the game for me from level 1 to 30. the halloween pole dlc is no longer there but  it basically made the game ez mode till i can afford to go to ocean places which probably wont happen because it is EXPENSIVE AS HECK to get poles and a boat and to buy the license to fish there NOT RENT for a few visits. so for now im just gonna stick with fishing for cats in missouri every now and then and walleye in emerald lake. which you also need a better pole becasue the walleye are SUPER far out there so you need to cast far. either way the game is good, but holy crap the pay to win is very difficult to get around. but if you can grind and grind your pay to level 16 and up then it will be worth it without having to worry about not having bait and stuff for bigger fish. also DLC farm with expensive prices, not worth it unless you REALLY like this game a lot

As much as ive been enjoying this game, im going to give negative review purely for their anniversary event.

4. That you pay for a expensive DLC that also gives you time on high level map that then has game breaking bug where cant get line to stay on the bottom and when you pick your rod it shoots over 100m back up off the ground.
The game is terrible. it freezes constantly. it's awful, really awful.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that high-level paid DLC packs include temporary pond passes with time limits that expire if players do not reach the required rank quickly enough.

citations.review_text:
As much as ive been enjoying this game, im going to give negative review purely for their anniversary event. 
1. They gave mobile and nintendo platforms 50% OFF Japan and Maldives DLC packs instead of letting everyone enjoy it. 
2. For the Catfish Treats Mission where if you run out of the 30 bait they supply they expect you to pay baitcoins to get more to try again.
3. Multiple anniversary missions had same problem as 2.
4. That you pay for a expensive DLC that also gives you time on high level map that then has game breaking bug where cant get line to stay on the bottom and when you pick your rod it shoots over 100m back up off the ground.

I originally bought this game with the understanding it was a fishing game that would, IF I bought certain DLC allow me to basically go fishing. 

 I purchased  the deep sea fishing DLC with boat only to have them change the game and make it impossible for me to use the purchased DLC any longer until i reached a certain rank.  This is pay to play at its simplest form. 

 The game is gorgeous, don't get me twisted here.  The fishing mechanics is one of the best I've seen in a game.  A little bit too technical for my taste when it comes to matching rods with lines and reels and such but it is manageable especially with a lot of the youtube videos out there.  

Still, if I pay for DLC, I should be able to PLAY with that DLC, not have to then earn the right to use it after the fact.

Update to this review:

I was contacted by a developer, Mariana-yana-kana and advised to contact support about this DLC issue saying they could basically explain the issue.  I Then went back and looked at the store page as I had a funny feeling I had overlooked something.

You see this game has more buy this pop ups than any game I have ever played and I have played a lot.  So I figure the way the developer worded her response, I had missed something and sure enough, I did.  

Definitely my bad for not seeing the little enjoy a 60 day cruise portion of a 59 dollar DLC.  60 days.  So I did as Marianna requested and this was my response.

My in-game handle is Kessryll and I purchased the deep sea fishing DLC, Japanese odyssey and Ocean voyager packs with boats.  I was able to fish there for a while then suddenly I can't.  I need to reach a certain level now to be allowed to go somewhere I have already been.  I now see that the packs say they are for 30 and 60 days.  

This is a very sneaky move on your part to make money, and you all know it.  I posted a review which I will amend since I did not initially notice the underhanded sales tactic that shows the number of days.  It won't change much…
